Usage of catalog:
  -all
    	also list the platforms this host cannot restore, with the reason
  -concurrency int
    	blobs transferred at once (0: 64)
  -json
    	print JSON
  -plain-http
    	talk to the registry over plain HTTP
  -publish string
    	publish this catalog YAML file to the registry
  -state-dir string
    	state directory (default "/var/lib/warmctl")
